frontier.hypothesis: The permuter can place const1 (li $t6,1) before bitpos's def at constant 67 insns, dropping bitpos ll 56->55 and flipping the RA tie to target (sum=$t2, bitpos=$t1) -> floor 9->~5.

frontier.hypothesis: BB2_SCHED_DEBUG / sched dumps may reveal WHY const1 schedules late (its sched priority vs bitpos-def) and whether any pre-sched RTL shape (not source order) biases it early.
frontier.mechanism: const1 is LICM-hoisted; its preheader slot is chosen by sched1 priority. Understanding the priority inputs could surface a legitimate structural bias not yet tried (or confirm none exists, hardening the permuter-only conclusion).
